cwe.definition: NVD placeholder designation meaning insufficient information was available to assign a specific CWE; not an actual CWE catalog entry.

vulnerable_function:
def import_book(dbook, in_stream):
    """Returns databook from YAML stream."""

    dbook.wipe()

    for sheet in yaml.load(in_stream):
        data = tablib.Dataset()
        data.title = sheet['title']
        data.dict = sheet['data']
        dbook.add_sheet(data)
patched_function:
def import_book(dbook, in_stream):
    """Returns databook from YAML stream."""

    dbook.wipe()

    for sheet in yaml.safe_load(in_stream):
        data = tablib.Dataset()
        data.title = sheet['title']
        data.dict = sheet['data']
        dbook.add_sheet(data)
